title: VS-22 — Multi-Source Business Discovery & Fact Reconciliation

notes: Adds one primary and up to two optional secondary public Business URLs to discovery; the owner-defined row order is authoritative source priority.
Every source is canonicalised in the mobile UI and authoritatively revalidated server-side before any external request.
Strict SSRF controls remain mandatory: HTTPS/443, no credentials, no IP literals, no private/reserved destinations, DNS/connect-time public-address enforcement, no proxy and no arbitrary redirects.
Bolt/Wolt inputs must identify one Business/venue; generic marketplace routes are rejected.
Google Maps/place share links use a controlled Google-only redirect resolver and the existing Google Places boundary; Google Maps HTML is not scraped.

Reconciliation is deterministic: higher-priority values win, secondary sources fill missing facts, equivalent values corroborate, conflicts/mismatches never silently overwrite or contaminate the selected Business.
Provider/source provenance remains internal and auditable while owner-facing confirmation copy remains provider-neutral.
Large public pages are read only to a fixed safe prefix budget; an otherwise useful Wolt page is not rejected solely because its total response is larger.
The existing Confirm and continue 5xx regression is a certification blocker for this slice.
No production release, production enablement or deployment-branch modification is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved the written VS-22 design: one primary plus up to two optional secondary URLs, add/remove controls, strict sanitisation and validation on every source, Google Maps/place support, source precedence, duplicate/conflict protection and auditable provenance.
Product Owner explicitly instructed implementation to proceed on the governed feature branch, with merge to main only after tests/certification and deployment remaining a separate explicit action.
